meaning: From no premises: Metaphysics IX.8, 1050b6-18, as Aquinas reads it (In Metaph. IX, lect. 9 n. 1-6), gives act's simple priority over potency in substance without any premise about motion, from five premises each needed: STMT-EVERY-POTENCY-IS-OF-CONTRADICTION, STMT-INCORRUPTIBLE-PRIOR-IN-SUBSTANCE-TO-CORRUPTIBLE and STMT-INCORRUPTIBLE-IS-IN-ACT-IN-SUBSTANCE (sourced), and two unattributed hypotheses stated inside the facts, that some being is incorruptible simply and that priority in substance is simple priority. With non-simultaneity this excludes a first being's potency in substance. It does not reach STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY or the root's use of it in ST I q.3 a.1: a model of every prima via premise, the mover-priority bridge, the motion route's priority over potencies being actualized and all five premises has a first mover moved by none, first being and incorruptible simply, with a dormant potency in place, which In Metaph. IX, lect. 9 n. 6 expressly allows (nihil prohibet ... esse in potentia secundum quid). Not recorded as an argument for STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY. Discharges nothing.
